review:
Wild Million is a Vegas-style slot on a 5x5 grid with fruit and golden bells on deep blue reels and authentic casino sounds.

Its free spins follow a simple progression: collect four wilds to earn 10 extra free spins, with multipliers rising to 2x, then 3x and finally 10x, the same escalation as Loki Loot and Big Boat Big Catch. The bonus can be bought where permitted. BGaming rates it medium volatility with a 5,000x maximum and a 97.2% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 177 spins.
